classData.comment:
/**
 * Popover usable as tooltip
 * @class Neo.plugin.Popover
 * @extends Neo.plugin.Base
 *
 * @example
 *     module : Button,
 *     width  : 200,
 *     text   : 'Click Me',
 *     plugins: [{
 *         module: PopoverPlugin,
 *         align : 'bc-tc',
 *         items : [{
 *             ntype  : 'panel',
 *             headers: [{
 *                 dock: 'top',
 *                 text: 'HEADER'
 *             }],
 *             items  : [{
 *                 text: 'This is a comment about the button'
 *             }]
 *         }]
 *     }]
 */
classData.name: Popover
